veranderings.voor: Daarna het die pot gedroog en is dit in 'n vuur gebak.
veranderings.na: Daarna het die pot gedroog, en toe is dit in 'n vuur gebak.
veranderings.rede: The bare 'en is dit' leans on the fronted 'Daarna' and reads stiffly; 'toe' marks the next step, and the second clause then needs the AWS comma before 'en'.
In natural Afrikaans the place phrase comes before the predicate adjective.
In the previous sentence 'hulle' means the heads, so this 'Hulle' (the archaeologists) briefly points to the wrong noun.
